demo.banner: Browser demo (DuckDB-Wasm) · sample tables preloaded — write SQL / JOIN / chart right away. DB connections & AI need self-hosting.
demo.dataTitle: Connecting databases / uploading files needs self-hosting
demo.dataDesc: This demo preloads sample tables (orders / users / products) — head to the Query Workbench to write SQL, JOIN across tables, and chart. To upload your own files or connect MySQL / PostgreSQL, self-host to unlock.
demo.aiDesc: Text-to-SQL chat, the error doctor, and AI chart suggestions need a backend and your own model key. Self-host, then add your key under “AI / Models” (off by default, never shared).
demo.importDesc: Drop a file to parse it into a table right in your browser and query it — nothing is uploaded. Connecting MySQL / PostgreSQL or reading Excel needs self-hosting.

demo.uploadTitle: Drop a file here, or click to choose
demo.uploadHint: CSV / TSV / Parquet / JSON · parsed in your browser, never uploaded

welcome.heroEyebrow: Powered by DuckDB · MIT open source · self-hosted
welcome.heroParagraph: Put local CSV / Excel next to remote MySQL / Postgres and JOIN across sources, generate SQL in plain English, and chart with one click. No warehouse, no scripts, data never leaves your machine.
welcome.featuresHeading: One workspace for all your data.
welcome.joinCodeNote: → local file ⋈ remote db, DuckDB ATTACH, one query
welcome.joinDesc: No imports, no copying. JOIN CSV, Excel, MySQL and Postgres in a single SQL statement.
welcome.askDesc: Ask in plain English, AI writes the SQL, you review before it runs — never auto-executed.
welcome.doctorDesc: When a query fails, AI reads the real schema and returns a diagnosis plus fixed SQL.
welcome.chartDesc: Turn results into bar / line / pie / big-number, with AI suggesting the chart type.
welcome.localDesc: One-command Docker, your data stays on your machine, keys encrypted server-side.
welcome.demoDesc: DuckDB-Wasm, no install — drop a CSV and run real SQL instantly.
welcome.aiEyebrow: AI · bring your own model key
welcome.aiParagraph: Chat with your data, generate and rewrite SQL, explain complex queries, and get fix suggestions on errors. Generated SQL is always shown first and only runs when you click. Off by default, plug in your own model.
welcome.aiCheck1: Text-to-SQL: one sentence → a reviewable SELECT
welcome.aiCheck2: Error doctor: reads the real schema (incl. federated tables) for fixes
welcome.aiCheck3: Privacy: keys encrypted server-side, generated SQL never auto-runs
welcome.aiUserBubble: Sales by city last month, highest to lowest
welcome.aiAssistant: Here's the query — confirm to run it:
welcome.aiInputPlaceholder: Ask the data assistant… (Enter to send)
welcome.cmpHeading: Filling the gap between database GUIs and BI tools.
welcome.cmpParagraph: Database clients can't touch your local files; BI tools make you build a warehouse and run ETL first. DuckQuery sits in the middle — query files and databases together, with AI to help you write.
welcome.cmpFootnote: Powered by the DuckDB in-process analytics engine — JOIN a 1 GB CSV with remote tables in milliseconds, no pipelines to maintain.
welcome.startParagraph: Docker spins up the full stack (Python + React) so you can read and write local files and connect to real databases. Just want a look? Jump straight into the workspace.
welcome.ctaParagraph: Open source, self-hosted, data never leaves your machine. Know SQL and you're set — if not, AI writes it for you.
welcome.footerTagline: A DuckDB-powered AI visual SQL workspace. One-stop cross-source analysis of files and databases.
welcome.footerBuilt: Built on DuckDB · data stays local

placement.helpText: ON-clause conditions apply during the JOIN and keep unmatched rows (shown as NULL). WHERE-clause conditions apply after the JOIN and filter out unmatched rows. When querying external database tables, add a time-range condition to avoid slow full-table scans.
